statement: Latest explicit user instruction outranks all stored HDC project records.
Verified GitHub main is the canonical HDC production source; archived ORVIA records are governance and history, not substitutes for live source.
Root /index.html is the canonical homepage source file.
Do not delete, rename, move, or clean up unrelated HDC files as part of normal work.
Normal production route is approved branch -> automated validation -> visual approval -> merge to main -> Hostinger Git deployment -> live verification.
A merge is not a deployment, and a deployment is not proof of a correct live render.
Hadi Digital Craft is a commercial printing-services business, not an equipment-sales business.
Core customer-facing services are Labels & Decals; Products & Object Printing; Packaging & Commercial Print; Large Format & Brand Environments.
Events & Personalisation is an application category, not a core service.
UV DTF, Offset, and Large Format are production methods subordinate to application-led service architecture.

Do not invent capacity, machine specifications, turnaround, certifications, sustainability claims, durability figures, universal compatibility, color tolerances, volume statistics, project outcomes, or client attribution.

HDC visual doctrine is Engineered Tactility: printing is demonstrated through physical evidence such as substrate, ink, transfer, surface, pressure, registration, texture, reflection, edge definition, scale, and precision.
Approved benchmark combines museum-like object photography, forensic material detail, credible print engineering, and editorial sequencing.
HDC visual prompts follow object -> substrate -> graphic system -> process -> physical behavior -> lighting -> camera/lens -> composition -> process-specific imperfections -> negative constraints.
Lighting should reveal the real finish behavior rather than exaggerate effects.
Avoid generic luxury props, neon/cyberpunk treatment, artificial glow, plastic-looking paper, impossible relief, fake text, and generic AI mockup aesthetics.
Product Universe uses native horizontal browsing: user-owned swipe/trackpad scroll, no autoplay, no clones, no infinite loop, no vertical wheel hijacking.

Production Register and Material Aperture use persistent expanding panels with explicit click/tap state, one active panel, Escape close, keyboard focus movement, outside-click close, and non-essential hover enhancement.
Finishing & Embellishment uses an interactive editorial register; Quality may share the geometry but remain a static informational register.
Mobile is independently composed rather than a compressed desktop layout; critical behavior cannot depend on hover.
Homepage symmetry means repeated axes, mirrored imbalance, predictable spacing, and deliberate full-bleed interruptions rather than universal centering.
The homepage uses a controlled sequence of composition families and may oscillate left-heavy, right-heavy, modular, immersive, mirrored, and quiet states.

Preferred execution loop is verify main -> audit -> failure analysis -> isolate branch -> implement smallest unit -> static validate -> diff lock -> PR -> integration guard -> merge -> live visual QA -> micro-surgery if required -> record.
When a write returns an uncertain completion state, re-fetch branch state and compare against main before retrying; apply only missing changes.
Before implementation, enumerate the allowed files/DOM scope so regression risk is explicit and measurable.
Hostinger Git integration is the approved normal deployment route; AI Builder and routine manual public_html uploads are not production routes.
Apex, www, /index.html, critical routes, and key assets must be checked independently after release.
A green CI workflow can be a false positive when live-verification steps are skipped or use a non-unique smoke signature.
DNS changes require reading the complete zone first and preserving mail/authentication records; destructive Hostinger warnings require an explicit stop.
Surface Lab must distinguish machine-compatible, substrate-qualified, and HDC production-approved states.
Canonical HDC surface statuses are UNTESTED -> EXPERIMENTAL -> VALIDATED -> PRODUCTION APPROVED -> RESTRICTED -> RETIRED.
Surface Lab content is partitioned into PUBLIC, CONDITIONAL, INTERNAL, and BLOCKED classes.
Unknown or unvalidated surfaces should route toward sample testing/review rather than direct production guarantees.
Earlier HDC handoffs positioned DTF printing as a top-level service.
The repository document docs/design.md contains an earlier dark/cyber-teal Stitch-era visual/component direction and homepage structure.

The September 2 current-production document describes a 12-section homepage; later September 26 work evolved the homepage into a richer sequence including Product Universe, Production Register, Material Aperture, Quality register, and Selected Work pause.
The exact final Hostinger hPanel button/confirmation sequence that resolved the apex-domain routing incident was not observed and must not be invented.
Repository/live canonical and social URLs should be rechecked because older source pages may still contain hostingersite.com references after the apex-domain correction.
The integration guard should be rechecked for false-green behavior: missing HDC_LIVE_URL can skip live verification, and generic homepage text may not uniquely fingerprint the approved release.
